tasks.prompt: Read the supplied R14H evidence and report object, mesh, material, UV, armature, shape-key, vertex and triangle inventory. Do not infer absent data.
Independently reconstruct the exact scene inventory from supplied evidence and flag contradictory counts.
Extract only verified Blender scene inventory facts. Separate FACT, INFERENCE and UNKNOWN.
Audit scene inventory values for internal consistency and provide evidence pointers.
Classify topology findings: true boundary/non-manifold, UV or normal split, duplicate-position seam, or unknown. Do not modify anything.
Independently assess whether the reported 147128 boundary edges represent geometric holes after coordinate welding evidence is considered.
Identify retopology-critical zones for rigging: face, eyelids, mouth, shoulders, pelvis, fingers, coat and hair attachments.
Produce a fail-closed topology readiness verdict for rigging from evidence only.
Classify face, hair, body, outfit, hands and feet defects from the 13-view evidence. Preserve canon ambiguities as unknowns.
Find only defects visible in at least one supplied view and distinguish texture-dependent detail from geometry.
Rank local repair candidates without proposing regeneration unless evidence proves it unavoidable.
Audit whether whole-model preservation remains justified after all visual findings.
Analyze the hanging arm/hand-like structure beside the waist against FRONT, BACK, LEFT and RIGHT reference authority.
Independently decide which turnaround views should control limb pose and which should control side silhouette/depth.
List safe interpretations of the waist-side hand-like volume without changing canon or geometry.
Produce a fail-closed pose-authority decision packet suitable for a later retopology task.
Audit the one-material one-4K-atlas setup and distinguish current utility from production limitations.
Assess face close-up, color-boundary and shader-readiness limitations from the texture and UV evidence.
Separate improvements attributable to texture from improvements attributable to geometry when comparing R03B and R14A.
Define the minimum next material/UV evidence required before production shader work.
Compare Blender GUI/Computer Use, typed Bridge, MCP and headless routes for read-only scene inventory.
Classify which R14H checks are deterministic/headless and which require visual GUI judgment.
Audit plugin/Bridge/MCP capability claims against execution evidence; do not promote unverified capabilities.
Recommend FLASH_ALLOWED, FLASH_WITH_SOL_REVIEW or SOL_ONLY for each tool-route task class, with no production writes.
